conclusion.controller: bounded: attempts, records and cycles are finite in every scenario of the exhaustive model (no record is appended inside any cycle); max attempts {'retained_bundle': {'ACQUIRE': 3, 'ASSEMBLE': 3, 'DETECT': 3, 'EXTRACT': 3, 'LOOKUP': 3, 'NORMALIZE': 3, 'VALIDATE': 3, 'VERIFY': 3}, 'live_capture': {'ACQUIRE': 9, 'ASSEMBLE': 3, 'DETECT': 3, 'EXTRACT': 3, 'LOOKUP': 3, 'NORMALIZE': 3, 'VALIDATE': 3, 'VERIFY': 3}}
conclusion.live_capture_path: NOT bounded by the configured limits
conclusion.recommendation: Before Step 7, bound each live ACQUIRE attempt at the Stage 04 boundary, without changing Stage 03: run the capture in a child process in its own session and kill the session after T_acq = deadline_s + op_timeout_s + 30 s (240 s with the configured values); record the kill as a retryable ACQUIRE failure ACQUIRE_WALL_CLOCK_EXCEEDED counted in phi. Then live ACQUIRE <= (A_max + F_max) x T_acq = 9 x 240 = 2160 s and the investigation's operational bound is that plus the retained-path terms. An investigation-level total budget is then a derived constant, not a separate timer. Owner decision.
conclusion.retained_bundle_path: bounded under assumptions E-1 to E-5: 720.0 s of isolated-worker time plus finite local work

endless_100_continue.server: a '100 Continue' interim response every 0.5 s for 6 s

slow_header_drip.server: status line, then one header byte every 0.5 s for 6 s

experiments.transport: citerift.wiki.fetch.urllib_transport (the default transport of Stage 03 live captures)

assumptions.E-1: local file reads of regular files and SQLite reads of an immutable file complete (no FIFO or device substituted after Stage 03's lstat checks)
assumptions.E-2: write, fsync and rename on the local file system complete (network file systems are not supported, SPEC 10.1, RA R4-26)
assumptions.E-3: the isolated worker creates no process outside its session, so killing the session group closes its pipes and communicate() returns
assumptions.E-4: the process is not suspended (SIGSTOP) or starved; wall-clock bounds are bounds on the controller's own waiting
assumptions.E-5: BLOCKED is not a wait inside the controller: the process exits and a later invocation resumes; the calendar time until not_before is set by the server's Retry-After and the operator, and is not part of the operational bound

attempts.formula: ACQUIRE (capture): A + F; ACQUIRE (retained bundle) and every other step: A

execution_records.formula: 1 (created) + 2 per attempt (start, close) + 1 (stale_detected, at most once)

live_capture_design_s.assumes: the response head (status line and headers) and TLS handshake arrive within op_timeout; DNS resolution ends within the OS resolver limits

local_work.work: a fixed number of stat calls and string checks

local_work.bound: O(bundle bytes), bytes capped by Stage 03
local_work.work: open_bundle reads capture.json <= 4 MiB; artifacts <= 64 MiB each, named in capture.json; SHA-256 over those bytes
parent side: read the worker's JSON output

local_work.bound: O(units + identifiers), units <= max_refs = 20000, identifiers <= max_candidates = 50000
local_work.work: one pass over units, containers and identifier occurrences

local_work.bound: O(K x (events per key + Q)), Q = quarantined rows + invalid identifiers of the pinned index (a constant of the index)
local_work.work: K <= distinct keys + pairs queries on an immutable read-only SQLite index; each gather runs indexed selects and, for matched and no_record, a relevance scan of the quarantine table and of invalid identifiers
one pass over claims; schema validation
re-run NORMALIZE, DETECT, ASSEMBLE; re-check the chain
append, fsync, rename on a local file system

retained_bound_s.plus: finite local work L (below) and kill/reap latency per worker call
